headline: Julius Research's DeepFinance benchmark for measuring models on PE and IB workflows
body: Julius Research says DeepFinance is a benchmark for private equity and investment banking workflows, with average human time of 27.1 hours per task. Mean rubric scores put Claude Opus 5.5 at 54.8%, Claude Sonnet 5.5 at 54.6% and GPT-6 Astra at 54.2%. The 95% CI is 46.2 to 64.4 for Opus, 46.0 to 63.9 for Sonnet and 46.4 to 62.6 for Astra.
note: The top three sit close together on this test, so the ranking says little about which model is best.

evidence.text: An ultra long-horizon benchmark for measuring models on real-world Private Equity and Investment Banking workflows that would take a human professional between 20 and 30 hours to complete.
